decisions.reason: Its move from a mere mention in 2023 to a dedicated page in 2024 suggests performance at or above aspiration, so boundedly rational management would continue it.
A dedicated page in both years and explicit renewed promotion in 2024 indicate a product that is meeting aspirations and merits retention.

Because it remained only a website mention across both years, management would see weaker signals and some shortfall risk, but likely keep it one more year while using organisational slack to wait for clearer evidence.
As a 2024 launch with only early website mention, its results are still uncertain, and the firm would usually allow more time before reallocating resources unless performance clearly disappoints.
This new service is strategically adjacent but less proven than the hardware modules, so management would keep it for now while monitoring whether it reaches aspiration levels.
